snippet.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic - Demo Launch Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Hela: of Mice & Magic: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161310/Hela_of_Mice__Magic/

Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartwarming open-world adventure about the Kind Witch’s tiny mouse familiars, small acts of kindness, and the beauty of the Swedish wilderness.

Before you jump into the playful and wholesome world of Hela, try the demo, available now on Steam, Epic Games Store, and Microsoft Store. This little adventure will introduce you to Hela’s atmosphere and core gameplay mechanics — just a taste of what you’ll experience in full when Hela: of Mice & Magic launches on PC and consoles on December 1st, 2026.

Hela: of Mice & Magic Store Pages:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161310/Hela_of_Mice__Magic/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/hela-6d220a 
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012485
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/hela/9nmbdprkk1xf
Nintendo (US): https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/hela-of-mice-and-magic-switch-2
Nintendo (Hong Kong): https://ec.nintendo.com/HK/zh/titles/70010000100025)
